mentions.name: crit
mentions.description: A CLI tool for reviewing AI coding agent output like a GitHub PR. It lets users annotate and push back on changes produced by AI coding agents such as Claude Code and Cursor without making a full PR, and works on both agent plans and the code itself.
mentions.problem: AI coding tools like Claude Code and Cursor produce plausible-but-wrong changes with no easy way to annotate and push back on them without making a full PR.
